Ask My Docs

Twelve public-domain food-safety sheets, searched sixteen ways. The table is the saved evaluation. The winner is LLM chunks reranked by Groq. These are US rules.

Ask on this computer

This page shows the saved evaluation. A new question loads a local embedding model and keeps the API key on the server, so the ask box is not published here.

uv run python app.py

Then open http://127.0.0.1:8765/projects/ask-my-docs/
